units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 80:14">Targ. Ps. LXXX, 14</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:11">Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אהן ח׳ וכ׳</he> the swine is a moving privy.

<cite ref="Shabbat 155b:8">Sabb. 155ᵇ</cite> <he>לית … מן ח׳</he> none is poorer than the dog, none richer than the swine (finding its food everywhere); a. e.—Pl. <he>חֲזִירִין</he>, <he>חֲזִירֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:8">Gen. R. s. 63</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:4:15">Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46ᶜ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00720"><he>דִּיקְלִטְיָאנוֹס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Taanit 21b:10">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>איכא מותנא בח׳</he> there is an epidemic among the swine; a. e.—Fem. <cite ref="H00546"><he>חֲזִירְתָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite>, end <he>כהדא ח׳ וכ׳</he> like the (nursing) sow, the more their young fatten &c.
